content: Vitest vi API (vitest.dev/api/vi, fetched 2026-09-10): vi.mock is hoisted above imports; factories run once and are cached; Vite aliases work in the path string (so vi.mock('@/lib/telegram') works with @ configured); vi.hoisted for factory-referenced vars; default exports need explicit default key; importActual for partial mocks; {spy:true} automock keeping impls. vi.resetModules clears the module registry — dynamically imported modules re-evaluate (fresh module-level arrays/Maps) but STATIC imports are NOT re-evaluated and the mocks registry is NOT reset (use vi.unmock/doUnmock). vi.doMock is not hoisted, affects only next dynamic import. vi.stubGlobal replaces fetch; vi.unstubAllGlobals restores. clearAllMocks clears history only; resetAllMocks also resets impls; restoreAllMocks restores spyOn originals. Setup-file-imported modules are already cached and escape mocking — reset inside vi.hoisted if needed.
